initial_receipt.explanation: The upstream job corrupts source provenance weights before the downstream handoff. The top-level corpus has source_weight values 5,4,4,4,3,3,3,2, but the Job-2 input needs/evidence_sources contain source_weight values matching demand_score instead: 9,8,7,6,6,5,4,3. The supplied upstream code localizes this to select_demand, which writes source_weight from row.get('demand_score', 0) instead of the source_weight field. Job 2 then preserves and uses the supplied handoff ranks consistently, so the supported fault is upstream.
